translation: And I privately think that the six yang and six yin should all enter the brain; yang is outside and goes in front, yin is inside and goes behind, meeting and traveling, circulating without a head, dividing names wherever they are, with no reason for a separate origin. These are all conjectures, to be refuted by later people. Taking the eye as an example, the books say the eye is the orifice of the liver, and the essence-qi of the five viscera and six bowels pours up into the eye and becomes its essence; the essence of sinew, bone, qi, and blood, together with the vessels, becomes its system, which belongs above to the brain and comes out behind in the neck; this is one evidence of the six channels entering the brain. In the channel song, only the heart and liver channels connect with the eye system.
